subject.title: feat: bound raw transcript reads across replacements

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a durable schema-v12 transcript-generation migration and expose this generation-aware raw cursor API as a permanent Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The branch introduces both a persisted upgrade boundary and a public plugin contract; repository policy requires explicit acceptance for schema-version advances and compatibility-sensitive SDK additions.

options.title: Approve the durable contract
options.body: Confirm that generation rotation, cursor reset semantics, limits, and the v12 upgrade path are the intended supported contract, then continue normal PR review.

options.title: Keep bounded reads internal
options.body: Limit the implementation to the active-memory owner boundary and remove the public Plugin SDK export and durable migration until a broader API is designed.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Keep the PR as a draft while maintainers define the required plugin-facing transcript pagination and upgrade guarantees.

recommendation.title: Approve the durable contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that generation rotation, cursor reset semantics, limits, and the v12 upgrade path are the intended supported contract, then continue normal PR review.

likelyOwner.reason: Most likely available decision route for accepting a cross-cutting core state and Plugin SDK contract; repository-history ownership could not be established from the supplied context.
